BETA Close X Barratt Redrow plc has announced the purchase of 1,000,000 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £50 million share repurchase program. These purchases occurred between April 7 and April 10, 2026, with the highest price paid per share being 274.20 pence and the lowest at 250.10 pence, resulting in a volume-weighted average price of 265.67 pence for the period. Following these transactions, Barratt Redrow now holds no ordinary shares in treasury, with 1,414,946,582 ordinary shares in issue, representing the total number of voting rights. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 13 April 2026 13 April 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transactions in own shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 7 April 2026 to 10 April 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from UBS AG London Branch ("UBS") as part of its £50 million share repurchase programme announced on 5 January 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from UBS as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Date of Purchase within Disclosure Period Aggregated volume (shares) Highest price paid per share (pence) Lowest price paid per share (pence) Volume weighted average price (pence) Trading venue 07 April 2026 250,000 260.0000 250.1000 256.7882 LSE 08 April 2026 250,000 274.2000 269.0000 272.1575 LSE 09 April 2026 250,000 264.8000 256.7000 260.6686 LSE 10 April 2026 250,000 269.0000 263.0000 265.6719 LSE To date, Barratt Redrow has purchased 11,680,000 ordinary shares in aggregate for cancellation from UBS in accordance with the Programme. Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,414,946,582 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,414,946,582.
